exposure: Maternal opioid use in pregnancy (indicated by infant with Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome (NAS))
cohort: The study included mothers of infants with Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome (NAS) and control mothers without NAS-affected births from England and Ontario.
finding: Approximately 1 in 20 mothers of infants with NAS died within 10 years of delivery in both England and Canada, representing a mortality risk 11-12 times higher than for control mothers.
